name: @aiti-ai/aiti-queue-keeper
description: Full queue panel for the composer (queuePanel-slot takeover): banners, row operations (move / drag / steer-send / to-followUp / recall / delete) and a recycle bin — fully client-side.

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 队列面板接管 —— 完整队列 UI（横幅/行操作/拖拽排序/回收站/撤销条/导入导出），core 回到上游同形兜底

soul: 排队不可怕，可怕的是排完队忘了自己要说什么。

soulI18n.en: Queuing isn't scary; what's scary is forgetting what you wanted to say after queuing.
